notes: Contract-first fixture (V2-PLAN Risk-3): the real endpoint is the Hermes gateway (https://jarvis.enriquecodes.com) but iOS builds + tests against THIS shape only. Both a native SSE form (event:/id:/data:) and the legacy JSON envelope (data: only) share one stream; clients MUST accept both.

response.offline_behavior: client enqueues an outbox entry (kind=send-message) and replays with backoff; the stream, not the POST reply, carries the answer

headers.Last-Event-ID: <int seq — client resume pointer; server replays everything after it>

event_kinds.message_start: payload is JSON: {"message_id": "<uuid>"}; begins a pending assistant message
event_kinds.token: payload is the raw text delta to append (may be empty); payload JSON may instead carry {"message_id": ...}
event_kinds.done: terminal; payload JSON: {"message_id": "<uuid>"}; client commits status=sent
event_kinds.stop: terminal; generation was stopped; client freezes partial text as sent
event_kinds.error: terminal; payload JSON: {"message_id": "<uuid>", "message": "<reason>"}; client marks failed + offers retry
event_kinds.heartbeat: comment/keepalive form only — ': hb' lines; NOT required to appear as events

event_id_rules: ids are monotonically increasing integers (string form on the wire); resume = reconnect with Last-Event-ID = last applied id; duplicates/replays after resume MUST be idempotent client-side
